description: Defines a template class 'IteratorType' within the 'Thunder::RPC' namespace, implementing an iterator pattern over a container with various constructors, navigation methods, and reference counting interface methods.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A template class implementing an iterator over a container, supporting navigation, reset, and reference counting.

methods.name: IteratorType
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the iterator with various container types or interface pointers.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Pure virtual method for reference counting.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Pure virtual method for reference counting.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the container.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the container.
